_comment: Provenance of every cached source the M0 claim suite reads. 'bytes' and 'sha256' are of the DECOMPRESSED document; 'utf8_chars' is its length as decoded text. tests/test_conventions.py::test_fixture_provenance re-measures all three. The rai figure '456 935 B' in docs/verification/m0-literature-matrix.md is the utf8_chars count, not the byte size: the fixture is 462407 bytes, and a fresh fetch of the URL at 2026-10-13T00:17Z was byte-identical to it (same sha256).
